liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes of the World** (3 reviews): Reviewer finds it far too short, yet containing intricate ensemble playing; Reviewer finds the album version anemic but respects it as the seed of the song [4][8][10]
- **Stella Blue** (2 reviews): Reviewer was moved to tears by this studio version of Stella Blue; Compares well with live performances, with studio mixing and vocals but not over-produced [2][4]
- **Let it Grow** (1 review): Reviewer enjoyed Let It Grow and its segue into Row Jimmy [12]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Reviewer names Row Jimmy, along with Weather Report Suite, as a personal highlight [9]
- **Let Me Sing Your Blues Away** (1 review): Reviewer considers it the weak spot of the collection [4]

## The recordings

- **gd73-08-xx.sbd-wotf.davef.2522.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 14 songs; 69 min; rated 4.13/5 by 31 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the recording superb in quality, with crisp, rare versions of material; Reviewer notes funky keyboards and nice vocals, with a classic sound; Reviewer says Donna's singing and harmonies with Bob and Jerry sound especially angelic here [2][3][8][12]

## Around the show

- These are Wake of the Flood studio outtakes; the exact date and even the month are uncertain, a best guess [1]
- Reviewer thinks these versions were likely among the last mixes before the album was assembled [3]
- Reviewer says Stella Blue and Weather Report Suite show greater maturity than earlier work by the same writing partners [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-08-xx.sbd-wotf.davef.2522.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Transferred from Betty Cantor's reels to PCM, then DAT, then DIO 2448, then SHN, via Dave F [1]
